evidence_excerpts: Across 46 benchmarks, WCET-aware register allocation achieves an average WCET of 68.8% of traditional graph coloring, reducing WCET by 31.2%, while text size increases by 29.8% on average.
text: WCET-aware register allocation lowers WCET by avoiding spill code on the WCEP, even when this increases total spill code or text size outside the critical path.
